briefdescription.para: Phase 5-L01 — LLM Exception Safety & RAII Hardening tests.

detaileddescription.para: Exercises the exception-safety and RAII improvements introduced as part of P5-L01 (ai_working/PHASE5_HARDENING_DETAILED_PLAN.md):

listitem.para: KVCacheBuffer noexcept destructor contract when flush callback throws
GGUFLoader noexcept destructor + double-parseFile resource safety
Move/copy semantics for nothrow-movable LLM types
Null/moved-from object safety (operations do not crash)
Batch embed exception isolation (one-bad-item does not corrupt others)
Concurrent embed() calls do not corrupt shared state

detaileddescription.para: All tests are deterministic and do not require a real LLM model.
